display: Owned Xvfb 21.1.16 / Openbox 3.6.1, 1600x1000x24; authenticated loopback TCP X11; no installed user session

protocol.engine: offline; native engine synchronization not measured
protocol.cache: warm filesystem/JVM samples; no OS cache eviction
protocol.completion: open future followed by EDT barrier and !isLoadingFile
protocol.heartbeat: One queued EDT callback at a time, every 20ms; queue delay, not display FPS
protocol.phaseAccounting: Both versions prepare syntax on the worker. Baseline parse-build-tree is inside EDT file-apply; candidate parse-build-tree runs separately on the worker. Nested phases must not be summed.
protocol.otherWork: No local builds or test workloads ran concurrently with timing JVMs. No timing or GC outliers were removed.

baselineCompatibility.details: 9 independent file/komi/analysis/edit metadata expectations plus 4 file geometry cases

baselineThreadNegativeControl.details: SGF tree on EDT; GIB omitted the preparation worker

intermediateReplayNegativeControl.details: Before the next() guard, shared move/pass prefixes each called live clearBestMoves once

candidateHeadless.skip: SgfMarkupEditingDesktopTest; subsequently passed with a real display

candidateDesktop.details: SavedGameLoadDesktopTest (6 routes/failure/retry cases) and SgfMarkupEditingDesktopTest; required display enabled

combinedPullRequests.details: Final desktop includes preview failure isolation, saved-list retry, and analysis progress

validation.ci: Exact PR-head required CI is reported on the pull request; local checks are not a substitute.
